WITH sales AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, count(*) lines, sum(f.net_amount) gross_net, sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) staff_net, count(DISTINCT f.sale_date) trade_days, min(f.sale_date) mn, max(f.sale_date) mx
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' GROUP BY 1),
rets AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, sum(r.refund_net) refunds, count(*) n_ret
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' GROUP BY 1),
rpt AS (
  SELECT store_id, sum(net_sales_before_returns) rpt_before, sum(returns_net) rpt_ret, sum(net_sales) rpt_net, count(*) rpt_days
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT coalesce(a.store_id,b.store_id,c.store_id) store_id, a.lines, a.gross_net, a.staff_net, a.trade_days, a.mn, a.mx, b.refunds, b.n_ret, c.rpt_before, c.rpt_ret, c.rpt_net, c.rpt_days
FROM sales a FULL JOIN rets b ON a.store_id=b.store_id FULL JOIN rpt c ON c.store_id=coalesce(a.store_id,b.store_id)
ORDER BY a.gross_net DESC NULLS LAST

calls.statement:
WITH p AS (SELECT period_start_date s, period_end_date e FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period=2),
sales AS (
  SELECT st.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) amt FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key, p
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN p.s AND p.e GROUP BY 1),
rets AS (
  SELECT st.store_id, sum(r.refund_net) amt FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=r.store_key, p
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN p.s AND p.e GROUP BY 1),
names AS (SELECT DISTINCT store_id, store_name FROM dim_store)
SELECT rank() OVER (ORDER BY s.amt - coalesce(r.amt,0) DESC) AS sales_rank, 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, s.store_id, n.store_name, round(s.amt - coalesce(r.amt,0),2) AS net_sales
FROM sales s LEFT JOIN rets r USING (store_id) JOIN names n USING (store_id)
WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id NOT IN (SELECT store_id FROM ref_store_closure WHERE closure_start_date <= (SELECT e FROM p) AND closure_end_date >= (SELECT s FROM p))
ORDER BY sales_rank
